Claude Code Hooks: A Deterministic Solution
One of the most common questions I get about Claude Code is: how do I force it to use the right CLI command?
How do I get it to use
? How do I get it to call my wrapper script instead of using
directly? How do I block it from running certain commands entirely?
The obvious answer is to put an instruction in your
This works most of the time. But there are two problems.
This instruction is only relevant when Claude runs a package manager command. Putting it in

makes it global context for every task in the repo. LLMs have a limited instruction budget—around 500 instructions before they start getting confused. You want that budget spent on the hard stuff: planning, implementation, architecture. Not reminders about which package manager to use.

Claude sees the "use pnpm instead of npm" message and retries with the correct command. No instruction budget wasted, and the wrong command is impossible to run.
